nodes.description: Privileged owner address set to msg.sender in the constructor; gates delegate, _mints, init, batchSend and setTradeAddress.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of spend allowances, written by approve and decremented by transferFrom.
Whitelisted trading address that bypasses all sale restrictions in ensure().
Per-address counter of sales/transfers, incremented in transferFrom and read in condition().
Whitelist mapping set to true by _mints, granting unrestricted transfers in ensure().
Minimum transfer amount enforced by condition(); set by init().
Maximum transfer amount enforced by condition(); set by init().
Global per-address sale cap used by condition(); set by init().
Total token supply assigned in the constructor and never mutated afterwards.
Constant token decimals (18) used to scale supply and sale limits.
Token name assigned in the constructor.
Token symbol assigned in the constructor.
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address constant whitelisted inside ensure().
Deployer-only constructor that sets name, symbol, supply, owner and grants max allowance to the UNI router.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Core transfer logic: allowance check, ensure() gate, unchecked balance updates and _onSaleNum increment.
Public payable approval writer; no zero-address or event-only checks beyond mapping assignment.
Whitelist gate: owner, UNI router, computed pair, tradeAddress and canSale addresses bypass the condition() sale limits.
Internal view enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale restrictions based on _onSaleNum[_from].
Owner-gated function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address and calldata.
Owner-only mint function that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and whitelists the address via canSale.
Owner-only initializer of _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum; has no one-time guard.
Owner-only batch transfer that multiplies _value by _tos.length with unchecked arithmetic in a loop.
Owner-only setter of tradeAddress, which becomes a fully whitelisted transfer address.
Internal pure function computing the deterministic Uniswap V2 pair address used for the whitelist check.
msg.sender used as the token holder/spender in transfer, transferFrom and approve.
msg.sender used as the sole authorization check in the owner-only administrative functions.
Arbitrary delegatecall to an untrusted address executed inside the token contract context.
Unchecked allowance subtraction and balanceOf -= / += operations in transferFrom.
Unchecked _value * _tos.length multiplication and balanceOf -= / += operations in batchSend.
Recipient parameter of transfer().
Amount parameter of transfer().
Source address parameter of transferFrom().
Destination address parameter of transferFrom().
Amount parameter of transferFrom().
Spender parameter of approve().
Allowance amount parameter of approve().
Sender being whitelisted/validated in ensure().
Recipient checked against the owner whitelist in ensure().
Amount forwarded to condition() in ensure().
Address whose _onSaleNum counter is checked in condition().
Amount compared against _minSale and _maxSale in condition().
Target address of the arbitrary delegatecall.
Calldata passed to the arbitrary delegatecall.
Address whose balance is overwritten and whitelisted in _mints().
Raw token amount (unscaled by decimals in the assignment) used in _mints().
Per-address sale cap assigned to _saleNum in init().
Minimum sale amount (scaled by decimals) assigned to _minSale in init().
Maximum sale amount (scaled by decimals) assigned to _maxSale in init().
Array of recipients iterated over in batchSend().
Per-recipient amount used in the unchecked total computation.
New whitelisted trade address written to tradeAddress.
Factory address used when hashing the pair address.
First token of the pair, sorted against tokenB.
Second token of the pair, sorted against tokenA.
Local computed as _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
Loop index over the _tos array in batchSend().
Local pair address computed via pairFor() and used in the ensure() whitelist comparison.
Local deterministic pair address returned by pairFor().
